sin.name: long-answer-wait
sin.description: A deadline waits more than 3 seconds for an answer. A server, a sync or a process that has not answered in about 3 seconds is not working, and a longer wait only makes a broken run slow.
sin.rule: Wait at most 3 seconds for an answer. A wait that is not for an answer, such as a container starting or an image building, names its seconds in a constant that says so, such as START_SECONDS = 20, and adds that.
